blocks.text: The module documentation defines the authenticated socket abstraction, registry boundary, serialized send path, close event, and failed-handshake policy.
blocks.title: Connection responsibilities

blocks.text: make_envelope adds the protocol version, generated id, timestamp, payload, and optional run sequencing fields. error_payload creates the sanitized error payload shape.
blocks.title: Protocol envelope helpers

blocks.text: DeviceConnection stores negotiated identity and capabilities, serializes websocket sends, translates transport failures, and closes exactly once.
blocks.title: Device socket lifecycle

blocks.text: The abstract registry exposes add, remove, lookup, per-user listing, and count operations. InMemoryRegistry enforces one connection per device and identity-safe removal.
blocks.title: Connection ownership registry

blocks.text: HandshakeLimiter prunes expired failure timestamps, computes retry delays, refuses to extend an existing penalty, and bounds tracked addresses.
blocks.title: Sliding-window handshake budget

blocks.text: Module-level registry and limiter instances are exposed through getters and replaceable setters for integrations and tests.
blocks.title: Process-wide instances

gotchas: A superseded connection cannot remove its replacement.
Limiter counters are per process and successes do not reset failures.
how_it_works: Builds protocol envelopes with ids and timestamps
Serializes sends under a connection lock
Replaces and removes per-device registry entries safely
Counts failures in a bounded sliding window
purpose: This module is the socket-facing boundary for authenticated devices. It serializes outbound protocol envelopes, makes close behavior idempotent, tracks one live connection per device, and limits repeated failed handshakes by peer address.
summary: Defines authenticated device connections, per-process connection registries, and failed-handshake limiting.

symbols.summary: Builds a protocol/v1 envelope with a fresh id, UTC timestamp, payload, and optional run sequence fields.
Builds the fixed-shape payload used by an error message.
Represents one authenticated websocket and its serialized protocol send/close operations.
Stores connection identity and initializes send and close synchronization state.
Reports whether the connection has been marked closed.
Encodes and sends an existing envelope under the per-connection send lock.
Builds and sends one envelope, returning it for replay bookkeeping.
Requests websocket closure once and wakes waiters even when the transport is already gone.
Abstracts process-local lookup and replacement of one live connection per device.
Registers a connection and reports the previous connection for the same device.
Removes a connection only if it is still the current device entry.
Looks up the current connection for a user and device.
Returns the current connections belonging to one user.
Counts registered live connections.
Stores current connections in a nested user-to-device in-memory mapping.
Deletes the matching current connection and removes empty user buckets.
Tracks failed handshakes per address in a bounded sliding time window.
Stores limiter thresholds and initializes the ordered failure table.
Normalizes an empty or non-string peer address to the unknown bucket.
Removes expired failures for one address and returns its remaining timestamps.
Returns zero when an address may retry or the rounded wait until its oldest failure expires.
Records a failed handshake unless the address is already limited, then enforces the tracking bound.
Sweeps expired buckets and evicts oldest tracked addresses beyond the configured bound.

unknowns: Cross-process presence and a Redis-backed limiter are described as later integrations, not implemented here.
